description: This file defines classes and functions for auto-functionalization of mutable tensor operations in PyTorch, including handling of views, schema management, and higher-order operator wrappers for auto-functionalization, with support for different modes like FakeTensor and ProxyTensor.

classes.name: SchemaHolder
classes.description: Holds a torch.FunctionSchema and provides methods for equality, hashing, and creating from a pytree TreeSpec.

classes.name: ViewInfo
classes.description: Abstract base class for view information, with subclasses for specific view types.

classes.name: AsStridedViewInfo
classes.description: Stores information for an as_strided view and can regenerate the view.

classes.name: SliceViewInfo
classes.description: Stores information for a slice view and can regenerate the view.

classes.name: AliasViewInfo
classes.description: Represents an alias view, regenerating via torch.ops.aten.alias.default.

classes.name: NotView
classes.description: Represents a non-view tensor, returning the original tensor.

classes.name: AutoFunctionalized
classes.description: HigherOrderOperator subclass that wraps an operator to run its functional version.

classes.name: FunctionalCallableWithEpilogue
classes.description: Wraps a callable to apply torch.func.functionalize during call, supporting inlining of epilogue graphs.

methods.name: get_base
methods.description: Returns the base tensor, considering inference mode.

methods.name: is_alias
methods.description: Checks if two tensors are aliasing based on storage offset, stride, and size.

methods.name: try_use_slice
methods.description: Determines if a tensor can be represented as a slice of a base tensor.

methods.name: write_view_information_to_args
methods.description: Writes view info into kwargs for mutable tensor arguments.

methods.name: read_view_information_from_args
methods.description: Reads view info from kwargs for mutable tensor arguments.

methods.name: can_auto_functionalize
methods.description: Determines if an operator can be auto-functionalized based on schema and other criteria.

methods.name: get_mutable_args_from_schema
methods.description: Extracts mutable argument names and types from a schema.

methods.name: get_mutable_args
methods.description: Gets mutable argument names and types from an OpOverload.

methods.name: do_auto_functionalize
methods.description: Performs auto-functionalization of an operator call, replacing mutated inputs with functional outputs.

methods.name: auto_functionalized_dense
methods.description: Implementation of auto-functionalization for dense tensors, cloning mutable args.

methods.name: auto_functionalized_fake
methods.description: Implementation for auto-functionalization in FakeTensor mode.

methods.name: auto_functionalized_proxy
methods.description: Implementation for auto-functionalization in ProxyTensor mode, with proxy tracing.

methods.name: auto_functionalized_v2_dense
methods.description: Enhanced auto-functionalization for view tensors, handling bases.

methods.name: auto_functionalized_v2_proxy
methods.description: V2 version for ProxyTensor mode, with materialization of callable inputs.
